lines: <ce>     A notice is nailed to a post across the market lane:
<ce>
<ce>               BY ORDER OF THE REEVE OF CHARING
<ce>      The market square is closed. A strongbox holding the
<ce>      stallholders' takings was stolen in the night. It will
<ce>      be well rewarded to whoever brings it to _warden_,
<ce>         the market warden, who waits at _inn_.
<ce>            The square opens again at first light.
<ce>   The reeve has shut the market square until that strongbox turns up.
<ce>      _warden_ is sitting in _inn_, cursing the night watch.
<ce>  Somebody was seen carrying a box into _hideout_ in the small hours.
<ce>               The strongbox! And the lock still whole.
<ce>            The reeve will be glad of this, and so am I.
<ce>         Here, _gold_ gold, as the notice said. I'll have
<ce>             those carts out of the lane within the hour.
<ce>      At first light the reeve's men drag the carts and crates
<ce>      out of the market lane. Charing's market square is open
<ce>      again, strongbox or no.
%qdt:
Charing's market square is barred: a strongbox
of the stallholders' takings was stolen in the
night. _warden_, the market warden, waits at
_inn_ and will reward whoever returns it.
The square opens again at first light.
